attribution.title: Manitoba Museum exterior
attribution.author: TMMCommunications
attribution.description: An exterior shot of the Manitoba Museum, located in Winnipeg, Manitoba. Image shows Museum sign with a large red "M," and text reading "Manitoba Museum / Nature - Hisotry - Science". Part of the Museum tower itself is in the background, with banners reading "History / Nature / Science". The Museum's Planetarium theatre dome is visible, as well as the Museum's 9,750 sq-ft Alloway Hall.

attribution.author: Urim Iyasere
attribution.description: Pinawa Dam Provincial Park was designated a provincial park by the Government of Manitoba in 1985. The park is .25 square kilometres (0.097 sq mi) in size. It is located north of Pinawa on Hwy 520. The park is considered to be a Class V protected area under the IUCN protected area management categories.
